items.summary: Seeking Alpha reported that traders were passing around a Betaville “uncooked” alert, or early, unverified chatter, on takeover talks for PayPal.

items.title: How Much Upside Does PayPal Stock Have Without A Buyer?
items.summary: PayPal (PYPL) stock has gained about 24% over the past three months (as of Sept. 24, 2026), but it is still down 21% over the past year. In late August, the shares fell 13% in premarket trading after Bloomberg News reported that a consortium of Advent International and Stripe had abandoned its pursuit of PayPal.

items.title: How Has Visa's Growth Story Changed?
items.summary: Visa's management tells its growth story differently than it did two years ago. That matters for your money. The shares cost 31 times a year of earnings, against 22.4 times for the S&P 500. A price that high assumes the growth keeps coming. One label that used to feature in Visa's results has faded. Which part of the business did Visa's management use to highlight in its quarterly results.

items.title: What Would You Have Needed To Notice In Coinbase Stock?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) shares returned 40% over the three months that ended on September 24. A $10,000 holding at the start of that window was worth about $13,980 at the end. The run came even as revenue kept falling. Management had been saying for well over a year that it wanted to go beyond trading, but the latest filed numbers pointed the other way.

items.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) is back in focus after Meta folded its Muse AI shopping assistant into PayPal’s global merchant network, letting users move from product discovery to PayPal powered checkout inside the agent.
